name: DIALOG
recent: Dialog Group Berhad 于2026年11月19日召开第38届常年股东大会，股东批准了截至2026年6月30日财年的每股3.0仙终期单层股息，并重新选举数名董事；第9项普通决议被撤回。公司随后公布2026年9月30日止季度业绩，营收同比增长19.8%，净利同比增长17.9%。此外，公司因员工行使雇员认股计划（ESOS）而发行583万3600股新股，并有多名董事在多个委员会中职务变动。
notable: 第38届常年股东大会于2026年11月19日举行，股东批准每股3.0仙终期单层股息，第9项普通决议被撤回。
因员工行使ESOS，公司发行5,833,600股新股，发行价每股RM1.62，上市日期为2026年11月30日。
公司公布2026年9月30日止季度业绩，营收7亿8704万4000令吉，净利1亿6507万9000令吉。
risks: 公告标题显示有一项清盘/接管人/限制令/特别管理人的公告，但未提供内文详情。
第38届常年股东大会的第9项普通决议被撤回。
earnings: 2026年9月30日止季度营收为7亿8704万4000令吉，环比增长1.6%，同比增长19.8%；净利为1亿6507万9000令吉，环比下降1.4%，同比增长17.9%；净利率为21.0%，低于上一季度的21.6%。

recent_en: Dialog Group Berhad held its 38th Annual General Meeting on 19 November 2026, where shareholders approved a final single-tier cash dividend of 3.0 sen per share for FY ended 30 June 2026 and re-elected several directors; Ordinary Resolution 9 was withdrawn. The company subsequently reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue up 19.8% year-on-year and net income up 17.9% year-on-year. In addition, the company issued 5,833,600 new shares following the exercise of options under its Employees' Share Option Scheme (ESOS), and several directors had changes in various board committee memberships.
notable_en: The 38th AGM was held on 19 November 2026; shareholders approved a final single-tier dividend of 3.0 sen per share, and Ordinary Resolution 9 was withdrawn.
The company issued 5,833,600 new shares at RM1.62 per share upon exercise of ESOS options, with listing date on 30 November 2026.
The company reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue of RM787,044,000 and net income of RM165,079,000.
risks_en: An announcement titled Winding Up / Receiver & Manager / Restraining Order / Special Administrator was made, but no details were provided in the text.
Ordinary Resolution 9 at the 38th AGM was withdrawn.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM787,044,000, up 1.6% quarter-on-quarter and up 19.8% year-on-year; net income was RM165,079,000, down 1.4% quarter-on-quarter and up 17.9% year-on-year; net margin was 21.0%, lower than 21.6% in the previous quarter.
